description: Source code for GraphPasses in the torch::nativert namespace, involving graph node analysis, schema matching, and scalar overload selection.

methods.name: isScalar
methods.description: Checks if a Constant or Value is a scalar type (int64_t or double for Constant; SymInt or SymFloat for Value).

methods.name: schemaTypeMatch
methods.description: Checks if a node matches a given function schema, considering argument types and scalar conditions.

methods.name: selectScalarOverloadName
methods.description: Determines the appropriate scalar overload name for a node based on its target and schema matching.

methods.name: selectScalarOverload
methods.description: Traverses a graph to select and update scalar overloads for nodes, including special handling for aten.sub.Tensor.
